```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)
library(qs)
library(glue)
library(grafify)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
format_rmse_column <- function(file, label) {
  qread(file) |>
    select(-c(mse, log_mse)) |>
    separate_wider_delim(cols = 'ang_dens', delim = ", ", names = c("Likelihood (Model)", "Ang. Dens."), too_few = 'align_start')  |>
    mutate(is_inf = is.infinite(rmse_norm),
           rmse_norm = ifelse(is_inf, "--",
                   ifelse(rmse_norm >= 1e3,
                          formatC(rmse_norm, format = "e", digits = 3),
                          formatC(rmse_norm, format = "f", digits = 3))),
           symbol = case_when(`Ang. Dens.` == "star" ~ "\\star\\,",
                              `Ang. Dens.` == "mix" ~ "\\bigcirc\\,",
                              `Ang. Dens.` == "Both" ~ "\\circledast\\,",
                              `Likelihood (Model)` == "BezELS" ~ "\\bigcirc\\,",
                              TRUE ~ ""),
           fontstyle = case_when(`Likelihood (Model)` == "cens"  ~ "textit",
                                 `Likelihood (Model)` == "trunc" ~ "textbf",
                                 TRUE ~ ""),
           color = case_when(method == "Pseudo-BMA" ~ "DF536B",
                             method == "Pseudo-BMA+" ~ "2297E6",
                             method == "Stacking" ~ "F5C710",
                             TRUE ~ "FFFFFF"),
           styled = ifelse(is_inf,"--",
                           ifelse(fontstyle != "",
                                  glue("${symbol}\\{fontstyle}{{{rmse_norm}}}$"),
                                  glue("${symbol}{rmse_norm}$"))),
           !!label := ifelse(is_inf,"--",
                             glue("\\cellcolor[HTML]{{{color}}}{styled}"))) |>
    select(all_of(label)) 
}
```


```{r echo=FALSE}
cols <- list(
  format_rmse_column("figures/is_preds_boxplots/joint/mse_tables/gauss_low_b1_all_both_ang.qs",  "B1low"),
  format_rmse_column("figures/is_preds_boxplots/joint/mse_tables/gauss_low_b2_all_both_ang.qs",  "B2low"),
  format_rmse_column("figures/is_preds_boxplots/joint/mse_tables/gauss_low_b3_all_both_ang.qs",  "B3low"),
  format_rmse_column("figures/is_preds_boxplots/joint/mse_tables/gauss_mid_b1_all_both_ang.qs",  "B1mid"),
  format_rmse_column("figures/is_preds_boxplots/joint/mse_tables/gauss_mid_b2_all_both_ang.qs",  "B2mid"),
  format_rmse_column("figures/is_preds_boxplots/joint/mse_tables/gauss_mid_b3_all_both_ang.qs",  "B3mid"),
  format_rmse_column("figures/is_preds_boxplots/joint/mse_tables/gauss_high_b1_all_both_ang.qs", "B1high"),
  format_rmse_column("figures/is_preds_boxplots/joint/mse_tables/gauss_high_b2_all_both_ang.qs", "B2high"),
  format_rmse_column("figures/is_preds_boxplots/joint/mse_tables/gauss_high_b3_all_both_ang.qs", "B3high")
)

full_table <- bind_cols(cols)
colnames(full_table) <- rep(c("B1", "B2", "B3"), times = 3)

kbl(full_table, format = 'latex', booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, linesep = "", align = rep("c", 9)) |>
  add_header_above(c("Low" = 3, "Mid" = 3, "High" = 3), bold = TRUE, line = TRUE) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"), position = "center")
```
